It also looks at how data fits into the policy-making process, from spotting problems and setting goals to tracking progress and checking results. It shows how data can help shape energy policies that work for everyone.

lessons.title: 第2课：数据在推动可持续能源和公平中的作用

lessons.aiPrompt: This lesson highlights the critical role of data in advancing sustainable energy and equity, emphasizing its use to track progress, measure impacts, and address disparities. Key tools include UNDP‚Äôs Energy Moonshot Tracker for monitoring global energy access initiatives and the World Bank‚Äôs Multi-Tier Framework to assess energy equity beyond basic metrics. It underscores the need for transparent reporting and ethical data practices to ensure accountability, build trust, and inform policies that balance sustainability with social justice.

lessons.title: 第1课：政策层面的战略能源规划
lessons.description:
本课程强调战略能源规划对于平衡能源安全、经济增长和气候目标的重要性。 它强调整合资源评估、利益相关者参与和长期目标的整体框架，以使政策与可持续性保持一致。

关键工具如能源系统建模实现了灵活的、数据驱动的策略，解决社会经济和环境优先事项。

重点在于随着技术变革和气候挑战而发展的动态规划过程，确保实现公平、具有弹性的零净排放未来的路径。
lessons.aiPrompt: This lesson highlights strategic energy planning as vital for balancing energy security, economic growth, and climate goals. It emphasizes holistic frameworks that integrate resource assessment, stakeholder engagement, and long-term objectives to align policies with sustainability. Key tools like energy system modeling enable adaptable, data-driven strategies, addressing socio-economic and environmental priorities. The focus is on dynamic planning processes that evolve with technological shifts and climate challenges, ensuring equitable, resilient pathways toward net-zero futures.

lessons.title: 第2课：项目规划、监控与评估基础
lessons.description:
本课程强调项目规划、监测和评估（PM&E）的基本原理，作为推动可持续能源目标的基本工具。

以本地所有权、利益相关者包容性和以结果为导向的有效性等原则为基础，PM&E促进透明度、问责制和适应性，确保能源项目通过反复学习和基于证据的决策实现公平、可持续的成果。
